goal: implementation plan item 6.5: at least three consecutive full-area runs, at least two normal noise seeds, at least one at the rated 10 km/h

configuration.probes: pause/resume retained-frame probe on; cancel probe off, as in the runs this compares against
configuration.seeds_passed_as: localization_config, so the shipped measurements.yaml is untouched and each seed is on the record

verdict: MET under the 0.92 floor adopted on 2026-09-12; NOT MET under the 0.95 floor in force when the runs were made
verdict_detail: Coverage, capture and image quality passed in all three consecutive runs. Steady RTF was 0.9588, 0.9450 and 0.9439: two of the three missed the 0.95 floor that was in force when these runs were made, and all three clear the 0.92 floor the project owner adopted the same day. The reasoning for the lower floor is recorded at REALTIME_FLOOR in tools/validate_rendered_linescan.py. Relaxing the floor does not explain the monotone decline, which stays open.

rtf_history.note: rated 10 km/h full-area steady RTF, oldest first. The first predates the q_z fix; the rest share the current configuration.

ruled_out.host_memory: 31 GiB total, 18 GiB free after the runs
ruled_out.gpu_throttle_flags: no thermal or power slowdown reported at idle after the runs

rtf_history.open: the three runs cannot separate degradation caused by running consecutively from a machine that is now persistently slower. The experiment that separates them is a cooldown followed by a repeat of the first run at its own seed.
rtf_history.what_the_floor_does_not_bind: the control loop had room to spare at the lowest sample: phase peaks of 6 ms against a 50 ms stall threshold and a 100 ms maximum step, with one stall record in about 120000 ticks across the three runs. Data validity does not depend on it either, since the encoder triggers by distance and the simulation clock is authoritative. What it bounds is wall-clock cost per run.

findings: Coverage is reproducible at the rated speed: three seeds, ten tracks each, every track [0, 100] with no unverified span, no quality flag and no excluded footprint tag. Block and row counts agree to 0.02 percent.

The gravity-reference acceleration gate at the rated speed is closed for 17.4-17.7 percent of driving time (86-88 s of 495-496 s), against 13.0 percent measured at 1 m/s. The three runs agree to 0.3 percentage points, so this is a designed quantity, not noise.
deviation_too_large fires at the rated speed for the first time (58, 8, 5 counts). It was zero in every low-speed measurement. The magnitude gate is real but rare.
Driving time is 495 s of a 760 s mission: a third of the mission is spent stationary in settle, handshake and step transitions.
The scan-slip audit paired 710 of 710 blocks with their images in each run, which is the first use of the new per-block pairing at full-area scale.
not_covered: a fourth run after a cooldown, which is what would separate consecutive-run degradation from a persistently slower machine
